profiles.source: https://huggingface.co/openai/gpt-oss-20b and the gpt-oss harmony guide
profiles.notes: OpenAI recommends temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0. Harmony format (analysis/commentary/final channels) is handled by the server. Reasoning effort is set in the system prompt ('Reasoning: high'); crit does not set it yet. The harmony guide says to send earlier reasoning back between tool calls of one turn; whether a server accepts reasoning_content in requests varies, so preserve_thinking is left off until the doctor shows it works.
